title: Stopping Grievous
description: In Pau City on planet Utapau, Obi-Wan Kenobi takes on opposite number General Grievous in a fantastic contest of strength and skill. The General is an amazingly powerful opponent, able to wield four Lightsabers at once because of cybernetic hands that deliberately split in half. Even so, Kenobi manages to gain the strategic advantage, sending Grievous fleeing on his wheel bike. The Jedi gives chase, riding an especially swift varactyl named Boga, and is soon right beside him. Eventually both combatants catch up with each other, and a high-stakes brawl ensues. Grievous is finally vanquished when Kenobi tears open his opponent's stomach plates and fires at living organs...using the General's own blaster...
